Messages.Author: Bishop Vesey's Grammar
Messages.Body:
What, exactly, do I have to announce when I announce an action?

Our group has used different things on this because we aren't completely
100% sure. The rules book doesn't make it exactly clear.

If I'm equipping Sasha Miklos with a Laptop, I have to announce I'm
performing an equip action but do I have to announce that I'm equipping a
laptop?

If I'm calling a vote, do I have to announce what vote it is but not the
terms?

If I'm Bum's Rushing someone, do I have to announce who I'm rushing?

I'm guessing (and we play) yes to all of the above, but I'd be interested
to know other people's ideas and/or the official version of the rules.

Thanks in advance,

James Coupe (if e-mailing replies, reply via jus...@bgrace.demon.co.uk)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Bishop Vesey's Grammar wrote:
> What, exactly, do I have to announce when I announce an action?

1) The acting minion
2) The action (bleed Prey, Legal Manipulations superior to bleed
MethA, hunt, call a vote: Kine Resources Contested, equip with
a Laptop, etc.)

The action must be completely specified, except in the case of
political actions, where the terms are not decided on until the
action is unblocked (although the actual vote - Kine Resources
Contested, Conservative Agitation, etc. - is announced at the
time the action is started).

> If I'm equipping Sasha Miklos with a Laptop, I have to announce I'm
> performing an equip action but do I have to announce that I'm equipping a
> laptop?

Yes.

> If I'm calling a vote, do I have to announce what vote it is but not the
> terms?

Yes.

> If I'm Bum's Rushing someone, do I have to announce who I'm rushing?

Yes.

> I'm guessing (and we play) yes to all of the above, but I'd be interested
> to know other people's ideas and/or the official version of the rules.

This is all official - good guessing on your part.
